import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
from scipy.stats import mannwhitneyu

# 1. Load clinical data
clin = pd.read_csv('cleaned_clinical_data.csv', usecols=['bcr_patient_barcode', 'surgical_margin'])
clin = clin[clin['surgical_margin'].isin(['Positive', 'Negative'])]

# 2. Load gene expression and extract MKI67
ge = pd.read_csv('cleaned_gene_expression.csv', index_col=0)
mask = ge.index.to_series().str.startswith('ENSG00000148773')
if mask.sum() == 0:
    raise ValueError('MKI67 (ENSG00000148773*) not found in gene expression data')
mki67 = ge.loc[mask].iloc[0]
expr = mki67.reset_index()
expr.columns = ['bcr_patient_barcode', 'MKI67_expression']

# 3. Merge and clean
df = pd.merge(clin, expr, on='bcr_patient_barcode', how='inner').dropna()

# 4. Group data
pos = df[df['surgical_margin']=='Positive']['MKI67_expression']
neg = df[df['surgical_margin']=='Negative']['MKI67_expression']
n1, n2 = len(pos), len(neg)

# 5. Summary stats
data_summary = pd.DataFrame({
    'n': [n1, n2],
    'median': [pos.median(), neg.median()],
    'IQR_lower': [pos.quantile(0.25), neg.quantile(0.25)],
    'IQR_upper': [pos.quantile(0.75), neg.quantile(0.75)]
}, index=['Positive','Negative'])

# 6. Mann-Whitney U test
u_stat, p_val = mannwhitneyu(pos, neg, alternative='two-sided')

# 7. Effect size: rank-biserial correlation
r_rb = (2 * u_stat) / (n1 * n2) - 1

# 8. Print results
print("Summary of MKI67 expression by surgical margin status:")
print(data_summary.round(3))
print(f"\nMann-Whitney U test: U={u_stat:.2f}, p-value={p_val:.4f}")
print(f"Rank-biserial correlation (effect size): r_rb={r_rb:.3f}")

# 9. Plot
sns.set(style='whitegrid')
plt.figure(figsize=(8,6))
ax = sns.boxplot(x='surgical_margin', y='MKI67_expression', data=df,
                 order=['Negative','Positive'], palette=['lightblue','salmon'])
sns.stripplot(x='surgical_margin', y='MKI67_expression', data=df,
              order=['Negative','Positive'], color='black', size=3, jitter=True)
# Annotations: medians, p-value, effect size
med_neg = data_summary.loc['Negative','median']
med_pos = data_summary.loc['Positive','median']
# position for text
y_max = df['MKI67_expression'].max()
text = (f"Median Negative: {med_neg:.3f}\n"
        f"Median Positive: {med_pos:.3f}\n"
        f"p-value: {p_val:.4f}\n"
        f"r_rb: {r_rb:.3f}")
ax.text(0.5, y_max + 0.1, text, ha='center', va='bottom', fontsize=10,
        bbox=dict(boxstyle='round,pad=0.3', facecolor='white', alpha=0.8))

plt.xlabel('Surgical Margin Status')
plt.ylabel('MKI67 Expression (log2 FPKM+0.001)')
plt.title('MKI67 Expression by Surgical Margin Status')
plt.ylim(bottom=df['MKI67_expression'].min()-0.5, top=y_max+1)
plt.show()

{"code":"import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
from scipy.stats import mannwhitneyu

# 1. Load clinical data
clin = pd.read_csv('cleaned_clinical_data.csv', usecols=['bcr_patient_barcode', 'surgical_margin'])
clin = clin[clin['surgical_margin'].isin(['Positive', 'Negative'])]

# 2. Load gene expression and extract MKI67
ge = pd.read_csv('cleaned_gene_expression.csv', index_col=0)
mask = ge.index.to_series().str.startswith('ENSG00000148773')
if mask.sum() == 0:
    raise ValueError('MKI67 (ENSG00000148773*) not found in gene expression data')
mki67 = ge.loc[mask].iloc[0]
expr = mki67.reset_index()
expr.columns = ['bcr_patient_barcode', 'MKI67_expression']

# 3. Merge and clean
df = pd.merge(clin, expr, on='bcr_patient_barcode', how='inner').dropna()

# 4. Group data
pos = df[df['surgical_margin']=='Positive']['MKI67_expression']
neg = df[df['surgical_margin']=='Negative']['MKI67_expression']
n1, n2 = len(pos), len(neg)

# 5. Summary stats
data_summary = pd.DataFrame({
    'n': [n1, n2],
    'median': [pos.median(), neg.median()],
    'IQR_lower': [pos.quantile(0.25), neg.quantile(0.25)],
    'IQR_upper': [pos.quantile(0.75), neg.quantile(0.75)]
}, index=['Positive','Negative'])

# 6. Mann-Whitney U test
u_stat, p_val = mannwhitneyu(pos, neg, alternative='two-sided')

# 7. Effect size: rank-biserial correlation
r_rb = (2 * u_stat) / (n1 * n2) - 1

# 8. Print results
print("Summary of MKI67 expression by surgical margin status:")
print(data_summary.round(3))
print(f"\nMann-Whitney U test: U={u_stat:.2f}, p-value={p_val:.4f}")
print(f"Rank-biserial correlation (effect size): r_rb={r_rb:.3f}")

# 9. Plot
sns.set(style='whitegrid')
plt.figure(figsize=(8,6))
ax = sns.boxplot(x='surgical_margin', y='MKI67_expression', data=df,
                 order=['Negative','Positive'], palette=['lightblue','salmon'])
sns.stripplot(x='surgical_margin', y='MKI67_expression', data=df,
              order=['Negative','Positive'], color='black', size=3, jitter=True)
# Annotations: medians, p-value, effect size
med_neg = data_summary.loc['Negative','median']
med_pos = data_summary.loc['Positive','median']
# position for text
y_max = df['MKI67_expression'].max()
text = (f"Median Negative: {med_neg:.3f}\n"
        f"Median Positive: {med_pos:.3f}\n"
        f"p-value: {p_val:.4f}\n"
        f"r_rb: {r_rb:.3f}")
ax.text(0.5, y_max + 0.1, text, ha='center', va='bottom', fontsize=10,
        bbox=dict(boxstyle='round,pad=0.3', facecolor='white', alpha=0.8))

plt.xlabel('Surgical Margin Status')
plt.ylabel('MKI67 Expression (log2 FPKM+0.001)')
plt.title('MKI67 Expression by Surgical Margin Status')
plt.ylim(bottom=df['MKI67_expression'].min()-0.5, top=y_max+1)
plt.show()"}
